title: GroUSE: A Benchmark to Evaluate Evaluators in Grounded Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of scores assigned by an LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., GPT-4) to identify scoring imbalances, such as an overabundance of extreme scores (1 and 5) and a scarcity of intermediate scores (2), and evaluating the impact of dataset debiasing/balancing on the trained evaluator.
